text:
The best hotels in Krabi, Thailand

Phuket and Koh Samui steal much of the limelight when it comes to the best hotels in Thailand, but the Krabi region – on southern Thailand’s west coast – is home to some of the very best places to stay in the country. It’s a place of dramatic scenery, from the sheer limestone cliffs of famous Railay Beach and the turquoise-hued swimming spots of Koh Phi Phi, to the mangroves and low-key beaches of Koh Lanta – a laid-back island that feels like a throwback to the Thailand of several decades ago. It’s also easy to reach, whether ifrom Krabi airport itself, or skirting across the Andaman Sea from Phuket, with a stop off on Koh Yao Yai along the way. If you’re longing for a slightly quieter take on Thailand – with the option to seek out the buzzier parts, before retreating back to your peaceful hotel – look no further.

For inspiration on where to stay in Thailand, visit:

 * The best hotels in Koh Samui
 * The best hotels in Phuket
 * The best hotels in Thailand
 * The best hotels in Bangkok
 * The best islands in Thailand


Varana Hotel

When many hotels in coastal Thailand opt for a traditional style, Varana’s slick exterior – with its six steel-grey buildings and breezy balconies – is a refreshing alternative option. In fact, there’s a more modern approach to everything here – this has to be one of the only hotels in Thailand that has its own climbing wall, and the gym, which is kitted out like a trendy commercial workout space, is far better than virtually every other hotel gym in the country (there’s also a spa for repairing muscles afterwards). Health and fitness is at its heart: there are four swimming pools, one being a huge Olympic size pool that's so big that some guests stand-up paddleboard down it, others with jets of water and a swim up bar.

The inside is just as pleasing: interiors are modern and stylish, with rattan chairs and cement-grey and white palettes in the 114 rooms. Dining is inexpensive and health-orientated, with fiery salads and a serious seafood menu. You’ll have to cross a road to reach the beach, but the beach bar, with its swaying rattan lamps and fairy lights, is yet another chill place to hang out here. A fun touch? The sage green tuks tuks, for moving luggage (and guests) between lobbies and rooms.

Price: From around £100 per night

Address: 258, Tambon Nong Talay, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81180, Thailand


Tubkaak Krabi Resort

You’ll immediately feel at peace in this boutique stay between Hang Nak Mountain and the Koh Hong archipelago. Everything has been cleverly crafted to ensure that – despite the villas and low-rise buildings around you – you’re still immersed in nature (a forest existed here before, and mature trees were built around instead of cut down). A stream runs from the mountains and along the hotel’s lush grass lawns (which are used daily for yoga practice) and the private villa pools are filled with natural water – chilly, but refreshing and pure.

title: Luxury Thailand away from the crowds: where to stay in Krabi
snippet: Where to stay in Krabi · Dusit Thani Krabi · Pulay Bay: a Ritz Carlton Reserve · The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort.
text:
Luxury Thailand: Where To Stay In Krabi

Head to Krabi for some of the best beach resorts in Thailand

Thailand’s southern regions are packed with beach and island experiences. On the western side of the Thai peninsula in the Andaman Sea you have Phuket and Krabi on the mainland and a number if islands off the coast, including Ko Phi Phi, the film location for ‘The Beach’. To the east of the peninsula in the Gulf of Thailand, you’ll find other islands including the very popular Ko Samui. It’s worth knowing that the monsoon season hits the western and eastern coasts of the peninsula at asynchronously, so check the weather before booking if you’re headed there August – November.


Bangkok Airways: Bangkok to Krabi

Krabi is a 1.5 hour direct flight from Bangkok, or you could fly into Phuket and take the ferry or a land transfer around the coast (by land it's about 3 hours). I flew down to the islands on Bangkok Airways who brand themselves as ‘Asia’s boutique airline’. If you're planning a multi-centre trip, Bangkok Airways offer a fixed-price air pass for 3 or more segments which can be good value.

They also offer a unique little benefit to make you feel special; all Economy Class passengers get access to a dedicated lounge in both Bangkok and Krabi. Here you’ll be able to make use of free wifi, plus there’s a selection of hot and cold drinks (no alcohol), and some nibbles including both Asian and western treats and popcorn. These kept the hunger from the door and kept a smile on our faces!

It’s about a 45-minute drive from Krabi airport to the main Krabi resorts and hotels and Ao Nang beach.


Dusit Thani Krabi

I stayed at the Dusit Thani, right on the beach. Expect really picturesque gardens including two or three enormous lily ponds. There are two beautiful pools to choose from, including a glimmering infinity pool with views over the garden towards the beach. The beach here is tree-lined, and all of the hotel’s sun loungers are actually on the lawn just before the beach, so you can lie in the breeze under the shade of tall trees without getting sand between your toes!


Pulay Bay: a Ritz Carlton Reserve

If you’re planning a holiday-of-a-lifetime, you should consider the Pulay Bay Ritz Carlton Reserve, a Middle-Eastern inspired oasis that offers you a personal butler and rooms with private pools. Every rooms has a truly enormous bed, spectacular bathrooms and secluded outdoor tubs, so if you’re looking for privacy, you’ll find it here.

There’s an immaculately sculpted pool area right beside the beach, a beach bar and a fantastic beach-front restaurant with its own infinity-edged pond. Yes, you’re picturing it correctly - this place has exclusive written all over it. But by the time we left, we were on first name terms with the staff and genuinely felt like ‘part of the family’. It may be exclusive, but there’s nothing ‘stuffy’; you can expect great service from people who are genuinely looking to make your trip as memorable as possible.


The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort

I’d seen photos of this secluded, wooden-style accommodation and leafy palm trees online, but turning up here brought the place to life. Honestly – this boutique resort stole my heart which is why I returned to stay here on my Thailand and Cambodia honeymoon.

The accommodation is in charming, two storey, wooden houses; several clustered round the central pool area and others on the beach. The whole resort is lush and leafy and exudes a really homely, informal vibe. The spa is located inside two cocoon-like structures; the implication being that you’ll emerge transformed after your treatment - ideal.

We visited the Tubkaak Resort & Spa for dinner and had time to enjoy a sunset cocktail beforehand. I don’t think I was prepared for how much of an event the sunset is in this area. The Tubkaak Krabi is a great example of what boutique hotels in Thailand are about; situated right on the beach with picturesque views over to Phi Phi Island. At sunset, you can recline on the beach on enormous bean bags and watch the sun dip low and turn blood red as it hits the horizon. What’s even better is that this reliable, spectacular sunset happens every day – it will fast become the highlight of your day.


Ko Lanta

During this trip, I learned that ‘ko’ means ‘island’. So the locals when speaking to you in English will refer to ‘Lanta Island’ or ‘Phi Phi Island’ rather than Ko Lanta or Ko Phi Phi.

Ko Lanta is a short distance from the mainland and the hotels here make for a great twin-centre break with those on the mainland in Krabi. We took the low-cost public ferry from the pier in Krabi over to Ko Lanta. It takes a leisurely 2-3 hours (depending on pick-ups en route), but you can opt for the much faster speedboat transfer to the jetty in Ko Lanta or direct to your hotel which takes about 20-30 minutes.

The ferry is a really good value and is a great choice when the seas are calm and you have some time. You’ll pass other islands and watch passengers from other islands pull up on traditional long tail boats to meet the ferry (which explains why it can take so long!). It’s a small passenger ferry (no cars) with an inside area and a top deck, so you can sit up top and lap up the glorious sunshine and views as you sail.

There are actually two islands here; Ko Lanta Yai (‘Yai’ meaning ‘large’ island) and Ko Lanta Noi (‘Noi’ meaning ‘small’). The day we arrived they finally opened the road bridge between the two islands, so you can now drive over, with a very short car ferry crossing from the mainland.


Where to stay in Ko Lanta


Layana Resort & Spa, Ko Lanta

I stayed in a Terrace Suite at the 5* Layana Resort & Spa, which is set right on the beach. I loved the layout of this hotel - everything is centred on the two palm-lined pools; an infinity pool right beside the beach and the ‘Wellness pool’ just behind it. There’s a beach front bar and informal beachfront restaurant as well as ‘Tides’ which is a smarter restaurant with a bit of a dress code.

For families or small groups who want their own space, there’s a beautiful house called La Maison. Complete with its own butler and extremely spacious private pool – you could stay here and be waited on hand and foot!


Twin Lotus Resort, Ko Lanta

Another great option for twenty and thirty-something couples is the Twin Lotus Ko Lanta. Rooms are modern and luxurious; some villas grouped around the gardens and some facing the beach. I’d say the ultimate ‘book-it-for-your-honeymoon’ room is a Deluxe Beachfront Villa – facing the beach and close to the pool. I nearly snapped it up there and then!

There are 2 pools here, one set back and an infinity pool on the beach, with a restaurant beside it. The food here is definitely worth a mention; we visited in April 2016 and were served one of the most delicious lunches. The Kiwi head chef who joined in late 2015 produced a delicious fish course, followed by a contemporary twist in Thailand’s favourite dessert that you’ll find everywhere in the south (Mango and sticky rice). He created a coconut pana cotta with a mango jelly which was absolutely divine!


Crown Lanta, Ko Lanta

Situated right at the southern tip of Lanta Island is the Crown Lanta Resort & Spa. If you’re looking for a good value, 4* hotel with a beach front reggae bar, this one is for you. I think it would suit you if you’ve graduated from backpacking but are looking for somewhere with a fun vibe. Families will like it too, with a large pool and plenty of pool access rooms.


Authentic Thai experiences to add to your trip


A Thai cooking class

I took a cooking class with the Thai chef who patiently demonstrated how to cook 3 Thai dishes, and then helped us to recreate them. I can’t say my effort was anywhere near as tasty as hers, but it did teach me the classic Thai flavour combinations; sweet, sour, salty and spicy. I find Thai food absolutely irresistible (particularly this southern, spicier variety), so I would highly recommend a fun morning spent learning to cook. Most hotels offer Thai cooking classes or we can easily arrange one for you.


Snorkelling and swimming trips to the islands

Krabi holidays obviously offer great opportunities to get out on the water. All of the hotels in Ko Lanta and in Krabi can arrange day trips including the popular island-hopping and snorkelling, and they make for a fantastic experience of these limestone isles.

From Ko Lanta, I took a snorkelling trip to Ko Rok National Park – a cluster of islands an hour off the coast by speed boat. Our trip took us to three different snorkelling locations and we were not disappointed by the fish – it was like something out of a tropical fish tank. The water here is balmy and warm, so it’s fun and easy to snorkel close to your boat.

Approaching the islands in Ko Rok is breath-taking. I think I’d always imagined that photos of this part of Thailand had been touched up, but I can see now that the sky really is that blue; the sea really is that shade of aquamarine and the sand really is that white. You can’t help but smile about that in the ‘Land of Smiles’.

(Just an aside: if you’re thinking speedboat = nausea – so was I... however we were offered seasickness tablets (which I took), but our trip in April was plain sailing all the way, not a ripple in sight). If you're headed to Thailand in December or January, I think you could expect broadly similar conditions.


Island-hopping amongst limestone karsts

Whilst you’re here, you should definitely take an island-hopping trip. One morning I took a longtail boat trip organised by the Layana Resort hotel. Half a day is plenty of time to experience the coast and be back in time for lunch.

We headed out from Lanta’s east coast, and sailed south between both Lanta islands through mangrove swamps populated by stilt houses and monkeys.

Not much further, you soon reach some magnificent limestone karsts off the western coast of Lanta. You’ll get right up close to see the caves and stalactites in the limestone – the rock formations are breath-taking; casting huge shadows over the water, with tiny isolated beaches hidden in nooks and crannies. Some trips will take you even closer, by kayak – so that’s on my list for my next visit to Thailand!

text:
10 Best Luxury Hotels in Krabi

Ao Nang


Ao Nang's golden beaches stretch against dramatic limestone karsts where longtail boats wait to whisk you to hidden islands. The main strip buzzes with energy—tour operators hawk adventures while open-air restaurants fill the air with garlic and chili aromas. After sunset, the night market comes alive with sizzling pad thai stalls and souvenir vendors selling everything from beachwear to local crafts. Getting around is a breeze with songthaews running along the main road for just a few baht. Most hotels offer pools and beach access, ranging from budget-friendly guesthouses to upscale resorts with spas. When hunger strikes, fresh seafood restaurants and street food vendors deliver authentic flavors without breaking the bank.


Railay Beach


Railay Beach's dramatic limestone cliffs tower over pristine white sand beaches only accessible by longtail boat. Rock climbing enthusiasts scale world-class routes while beachgoers lounge on four distinct shorelines. The car-free peninsula invites exploration along jungle paths leading to hidden lagoons, emerald pools, and the golden-stalactite adorned Phra Nang Cave. Beachfront restaurants serve fresh seafood and Thai classics as the sun dips below the Andaman Sea. Accommodations range from luxury resorts with infinity pools to budget-friendly bungalows tucked in tropical gardens. Everyone travels on foot here, with sandy walking paths connecting all beaches within a 15-minute stroll.


Nong Thale


Nong Thale offers a slice of paradise where dramatic limestone karsts rise from emerald waters along pristine beaches. This relaxing coastal area near Krabi combines luxury resorts with natural beauty, perfect for travelers seeking both adventure and serenity. Tubkaek Beach and Khlong Muang Beach provide ideal spots for sunset viewing, swimming, and kayaking through mangroves. Resort restaurants serve international cuisine and Thai classics with romantic beachfront settings. Car rental is essential as public transit is limited, though songthaews run to nearby Ao Nang. Most accommodations are upscale beachfront resorts and private villas with pool access and spa services.


Downtown Krabi


Downtown Krabi buzzes with local life around Maharaj Market's spice stalls and the vibrant weekend night market. Sample authentic Thai street food while browsing handcrafted souvenirs and watching locals go about their day. The riverside location offers stunning island views, with temple gardens providing peaceful spots to escape the tropical heat. Affordable guesthouses and hostels make this budget-friendly hub perfect for travelers exploring the region. Songthaews and tuk-tuks connect easily to nearby beaches and islands, while boat services whisk you to Railay and Phi Phi from nearby piers. The compact downtown area rewards curious wanderers with its colorful shophouses and genuine Thai atmosphere.


Sai Thai


Sai Thai tempts you with pristine beaches and dramatic limestone karst towers rising from turquoise waters. Explore hidden coves by traditional longtail boat, kayak through lush mangrove forests, or simply lounge on white sand beaches. The relaxed coastal paths offer stunning views of Krabi's iconic rock formations, perfect for sunset strolls or morning jogs. Dining options range from authentic seafood grills on the beach to resort restaurants serving Thai classics. Most visitors stay in beachfront resorts or budget-friendly bungalows nestled between coconut palms. Getting around is easiest with rented scooters or resort shuttles, with songthaews running to Krabi Town for those seeking city adventures.

Our stay at Baan Koh Kwang was nothing short of extraordinary. From the moment we arrived, we were hugged in warmth and hospitality by the resort owners. Their sumptuous al fresco dinners, shared with other guests, made us feel like part of a close-knit family. Initially planning a brief two-night stay, we were so captivated by the resort's charm and the owners' genuine care that we extended our stay to eleven days. Every thai meal prepared by Mommy Poy and her staff, from breakfast to dinner, was a delightful experience, made even more special by the owners' thoughtful and attentive service. They went above and beyond to ensure our comfort, arranging transportation and offering valuable recommendations for exploring the area. Nestled amidst a lush jungle, Baan Koh Kwang was an oasis of tranquility. The soothing sounds of nature provided the perfect backdrop for relaxation and rejuvenation. It was exactly the authentic Thai experience we had hoped for. Leaving Baan Koh Kwang was bittersweet, but we were touched by the owners' generosity in offering to take us to the airport. It felt like saying goodbye to dear friends. We are already planning our return and can't wait to experience this incredible place again. Baan Koh Kwang truly became our home away from home. Thank you so much Mommy Poy and Papa Charoon! Thank you much for making our holiday in Krabi unforgettable. It was a pleasure meeting you both. We will be back soon!

text:
Top 10 Hotels in Krabi (from $12) 2026 - Competitive Prices

Frequently asked questions


What is the best area to stay in Krabi?

The best area to stay in Krabi for most travelers is Ao Nang, known for its convenient beachfront access and a wide array of amenities.

Ao Nang serves as Krabi's primary tourist center, offering a long stretch of beach, a promenade lined with restaurants and shops, and easy access to boat tours. It's a bustling area with a variety of accommodations ranging from budget-friendly guesthouses to luxury resorts, all within walking distance of the beach.

For couples looking for a mix of relaxation and activity, Ao Nang is an excellent choice. You can enjoy the beach during the day, easily book island hopping tours to places like the Phi Phi Islands or Railay Beach from the main pier, and then find diverse dining options and evening entertainment along the main road.

Families will also find Ao Nang accommodating due to its varied dining options, accessible beaches, and the availability of family-friendly activities.

What are the best hotels in Krabi that travelers recommend?

Two of the best hotels in Krabi that receive consistently high recommendations from travelers are Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, and Rayavadee.

The 5-star Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, with an outstanding 9.8 rating, is a luxurious option with a poolside bar and beachfront restaurant. Guests can enjoy private pools, a swim-up bar, and champagne service. It is also conveniently located near Laem Bong Beach and Tubkaek Beach.

Another highly recommended choice is the 5-star Rayavadee, which has a 9.6 rating. This hotel offers private plunge pools, a poolside restaurant, and tennis facilities. It is uniquely situated near several beautiful points of interest, including Phra Nang Beach, Princess Lagoon, and East Railay Beach.

What are the best family hotels in Krabi?

For families traveling to Krabi, excellent hotel options include the Holiday Inn Resort Krabi Ao Nang Beach by IHG, Banyan Tree Krabi, The Scene Cliff View Villas, Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, and Sofitel Krabi Phokeethra Golf & Spa Resort.

The 4-star Holiday Inn Resort Krabi Ao Nang Beach by IHG, with an 8.6 rating, is a great choice for families, offering amenities such as sofa beds, a playground, children's bathrobes, highchairs, strollers, and a complimentary kids' club. It also provides cribs, books, and games for children, along with connecting rooms and a dedicated children's pool. Guests consistently praise its comfortable and clean rooms, excellent location, and friendly staff. It's conveniently situated near Ao Nang Beach and Pai Plong Bay.

The 5-star Banyan Tree Krabi, boasting an impressive 9.8 rating, caters exceptionally well to families. It features toys for children, complimentary cribs, outlet covers, child-friendly window designs, beach toys, a children's club, books, baby bathtubs, highchairs, and on-site babysitting services. A children's pool, supervised childcare, games, and sofa beds are also available. Guests frequently highlight the exceptional and friendly staff, as well as the tasty food. It is located near Tubkaek Beach.

The 4-star The Scene Cliff View Villas, rated 9.6, is another highly recommended family hotel. It offers a complimentary kids' club, kids' meals, games, on-site babysitting, complimentary cribs, baby bathtubs, toys, a playground, and a children's pool. Guests often comment on the spacious and clean rooms, amazing staff, gorgeous pool, and excellent breakfast. It's located close to Pai Plong Bay and Ao Phai Plong Beach.

The 5-star Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, with a 9.8 rating, provides a luxurious family experience. This resort offers children's slippers, games, a complimentary kids' club, a children's pool, supervised childcare, complimentary cribs, toys, and sofa beds. It is located near Laem Bong Beach and Tubkaek Beach.

The 5-star Sofitel Krabi Phokeethra Golf & Spa Resort, rated 8.8, is well-equipped for families. It features a complimentary kids' club, a children's pool, complimentary cribs, highchairs, supervised childcare, on-site babysitting, connecting rooms, and a playground. Guests frequently mention the great breakfast, amazing pool, and excellent service. The resort is situated near Koh Kwang Beach. Find more child-friendly accommodations in Krabi

What are the best 5-star hotels in Krabi?

For the best 5-star hotels in Krabi, consider Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Sofitel Krabi Phokeethra Golf & Spa Resort, Rayavadee, Hotel Adam Krabi, and Dusit Thani Krabi Beach Resort.

The 5-star Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, boasts an exceptional 9.8 rating. Guests appreciate its extensive amenities, including a poolside bar, a beachfront restaurant, and private pools. For those seeking great experiences, the resort offers helicopter and plane tours. It is conveniently located near Laem Bong Beach and Tubkaek Beach.

Another excellent option is the 5-star Sofitel Krabi Phokeethra Golf & Spa Resort, rated 8.8. This resort offers a swim-up bar, an on-site golf course, and private pools. It is situated close to Laem Bong Beach and Koh Kwang Beach. Guests frequently praise the amazing pool and great breakfast.

The 5-star Rayavadee, with a 9.6 rating, is a fantastic choice, especially noted for its location. It features a poolside bar, private plunge pools, and tennis facilities. It is uniquely positioned near Phra Nang Beach, Princess Lagoon, and East Railay Beach. Previous guests highlight the friendly staff, amazing food, and fantastic location.

Hotel Adam Krabi, a 5-star hotel with a superb 10.0 rating, offers private secured pools, plunge pools, and a poolside bar. Guests frequently praise its comfortable and clean rooms, friendly staff, and delicious breakfast. The hotel is located near Pai Plong Bay and Ao Nang Beach.

Finally, the 5-star Dusit Thani Krabi Beach Resort, rated 9.2, provides a private beach, a swim-up bar, and private plunge pools. Guests consistently mention the great staff, beautiful rooms, and quiet location. It is conveniently situated near Koh Kwang Beach. Find more luxury hotels in Krabi

What are the best spa hotels in Krabi?

For an exceptional spa experience in Krabi, consider Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Varana Hotel Krabi, Hotel Adam Krabi, Sofitel Krabi Phokeethra Golf & Spa Resort, or The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort.

The 5-star Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, boasts an impressive 9.8 rating and offers a range of spa treatments, including Thai massage, hot stone massage, deep tissue massage, and aromatherapy. Guests can also enjoy couples treatment rooms, a steam room, a hot tub, and a full-service spa with daily offerings. It is located just 0.9 miles from Laem Bong Beach.

Another excellent 5-star option is the Varana Hotel Krabi, with a 9.4 rating. This hotel provides a wide array of spa amenities such as sports massage, hydrotherapy, thalassotherapy, and accessible spa facilities. It's conveniently located near Laem Bong Beach (1.1 miles) and Koh Kwang Beach (0.2 miles).

Hotel Adam Krabi, a 5-star hotel with a great 10.0 rating, is highly recommended for its spa services. Travelers can indulge in couples treatment rooms, detoxification wraps, body scrubs, and reflexology. The hotel is situated 1.2 miles from Khao Ao Nam Mao and 0.7 miles from Ao Phai Plong Beach.

The 5-star Sofitel Krabi Phokeethra Golf & Spa Resort, rated 8.8, features a full-service spa with a Turkish bath or hammam, manicures and pedicures, and a hot tub. Guests can also enjoy deep tissue massages and various body treatments. It is located 0.7 miles from Laem Bong Beach and 0.2 miles from Koh Kwang Beach.

Finally, The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort, a 5-star property with a 9.6 rating, offers a serene spa experience. Amenities include massages on the beach, a sauna, and a steam room, alongside a variety of facial and body treatments. It is 1.4 miles from Laem Bong Beach. See all spa hotels in Krabi

Which beach resorts in Krabi do travelers love?

Two beach resorts in Krabi that travelers consistently love are the Dusit Thani Krabi Beach Resort and Amari Vogue Krabi.

The 5-star Dusit Thani Krabi Beach Resort, with an outstanding 9.2 rating, offers a private beach location and beautiful sea views. Guests frequently praise the great service, amazing staff, and excellent, beautiful rooms. It also features a poolside bar, sun loungers, and an outdoor pool for ultimate relaxation.

Another highly-rated option is the 4.5-star Amari Vogue Krabi, also with a 9.2 rating. This resort boasts a private beach location and is known for its comfortable and clean rooms, as well as its kind and phenomenal staff. It also offers couples dining experiences and a convenient area shuttle. See more stays near the beach in Krabi

What hotels in Krabi offer free breakfast?

In Krabi, several highly-rated hotels offer complimentary breakfast, including Hotel Adam Krabi, The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort, Nakamanda Resort And Spa, Anana Ecological Resort Krabi, and Varana Hotel Krabi.

The 5-star Hotel Adam Krabi, with an exceptional 10.0 rating, provides a delicious and amazing breakfast according to guests. This hotel is also praised for its comfortable and clean rooms, as well as its friendly and helpful staff. Nearby attractions include Tonsai Beach and Pai Plong Bay.

The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort is a 5-star hotel with a 9.6 rating, where guests rave about the delicious and amazing food, especially the breakfast buffet. The staff and service are consistently described as excellent and exceptional. The resort also offers free WiFi and complimentary self-parking. It is conveniently located near Tubkaek Beach.

Another excellent option is the 5-star Nakamanda Resort And Spa, rated 9.4. This resort offers a complimentary buffet breakfast and is known for its excellent food and extremely helpful staff. Guests also appreciate the clean rooms. It is situated close to Khlong Muang Beach and Koh Kwang Beach.

The 5-star Anana Ecological Resort Krabi, with a 9.4 rating, also provides free breakfast, including an English breakfast option. Guests frequently highlight the great and good breakfast, excellent food, and friendly staff. The resort also offers a free shuttle bus service, making it easy to explore nearby areas.

Varana Hotel Krabi, a 5-star hotel with a 9.4 rating, features a complimentary buffet breakfast. Guests consistently praise the great and amazing food, helpful staff, and excellent service. The hotel also boasts beautiful and spacious rooms, and a great spa. It is conveniently located near Khlong Muang Beach and Koh Kwang Beach. Find more hotels with free breakfast in Krabi

What are the top pet-friendly hotels in Krabi?

For top pet-friendly hotels in Krabi, consider the Varana Hotel Krabi, Doo Dee Boutique Resort by Swiss Chalet, ibis Styles Krabi Ao Nang, and Phanom Bencha Mountain Resort.

The 5-star Varana Hotel Krabi, with an excellent 9.4 rating, welcomes both dogs and cats and provides food and water bowls for your pets. Guests consistently praise the amazing and helpful staff, great food, and beautiful, big rooms, along with a great SPA. It is conveniently located near Koh Kwang Beach, just 0.2 miles away.

The 3-star Doo Dee Boutique Resort by Swiss Chalet, rated 8.8, allows pets to stay free of charge. This resort offers an outdoor pool with sun loungers and umbrellas, and a 24-hour pool for children. It is also well-situated for outdoor activities with mountain climbing nearby and mountain biking available on-site. The Ao Nang Landmark Night Market is just 0.3 miles away.

Another great option is the 4-star ibis Styles Krabi Ao Nang, which has a rating of 8.4 and allows pets to stay for free. Guests frequently mention the good breakfast, nice rooms, great service, and friendly staff. It is located 0.7 miles from Ao Nang Beach and 0.7 miles from Pai Plong Bay.

The 3-star Phanom Bencha Mountain Resort boasts a superb 10.0 rating and offers free stays for pets, welcoming both dogs and cats. This resort features an outdoor pool with sun loungers and free self-parking. It provides a peaceful retreat, located 11.1 miles from Khao Phanom Bencha National Park. See more pet-friendly hotels in Krabi

What are the top boutique hotels in Krabi?

For top boutique hotels in Krabi, consider the Holiday Inn Resort Krabi Ao Nang Beach by IHG, The L Resort, and Ava Sea Krabi Resort.

The 4-star Holiday Inn Resort Krabi Ao Nang Beach by IHG, with an 8.6 rating, is highly praised for its comfortable and clean rooms, excellent location, and friendly staff. It offers a variety of family-friendly amenities, including a children's club, a playground, and a children's pool. It is conveniently located 0.7 miles from Ao Phai Plong Beach.

Another excellent choice is the 4-star The L Resort, rated 8.6. Guests frequently highlight the amazing staff, superb location, and beautiful rooms. The resort features an outdoor pool with sun loungers and umbrellas, a poolside bar, and many rooms offer sea views. It is just 1.0 mile from Ao Phai Plong Beach.

The 4-star Ava Sea Krabi Resort, with an 8.2 rating, is also a great option. Travelers appreciate its location close to the beach and the helpful staff. This resort provides an outdoor pool, a poolside bar, and an airport shuttle available 24 hours a day, making arrivals and departures seamless. It is situated 0.7 miles from Ao Phai Plong Beach. See all boutique hotels in Krabi

What are the best budget hotels in Krabi?

For budget-friendly accommodations in Krabi, consider the Krabi Avahill, Glur Hostel, or LaRio Hotel Krabi.

The 3-star Krabi Avahill, with an excellent 9.0 rating, offers complimentary cooked breakfast and free self-parking. It is conveniently located near Klong Jilad Pier and Wat Kaew Korawaram, making it easy to explore local attractions.

Another great option is Glur Hostel, which boasts an impressive 9.2 rating. Guests benefit from free continental breakfast and a 24-hour airport shuttle. It is situated near Tonsai Beach and Pai Plong Bay, offering easy access to beautiful coastal areas.

The 3-star LaRio Hotel Krabi, rated 7.6, provides a refreshing pool and complimentary amenities such as a minibar with stocked items and a beach shuttle. It is close to Ao Nang Beach and Pai Plong Bay, ideal for those looking to enjoy the seaside. View all budget hotels in Krabi

What are the most romantic hotels in Krabi for couples?

For romantic getaways in Krabi, couples have several excellent choices, including Hotel Adam Krabi, Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Rayavadee, The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort, and Banyan Tree Krabi.

The 5-star Hotel Adam Krabi, boasting a superb 10.0 rating, offers a range of couples-focused amenities such as couples dining experiences, dedicated couples treatment rooms, and various massages including deep tissue, Swedish, Thai, and hot stone. Guests consistently praise the comfortable and clean rooms, the friendly and helpful staff, and the delicious breakfast.

Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, is a 5-star property with an impressive 9.8 rating. This resort features couples dining, a full-service spa with a steam room, sauna, hot tub, and various treatments like Thai massage, hot stone massage, and aromatherapy.

The 5-star Rayavadee, rated 9.6, is known for its beautiful outdoor pools, some with private plunge pools, and a poolside bar. It is exceptionally located near stunning beaches like Phra Nang Beach and West Railay Beach. Guests frequently highlight the friendly staff, amazing food, and fantastic location.

The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort, a 5-star hotel with a 9.6 rating, provides amenities such as massages on the beach and a complimentary buffet breakfast. Its exceptional service and delicious food are often mentioned in guest reviews.

Finally, the 5-star Banyan Tree Krabi, with a 9.8 rating, offers private pools, outdoor pools with sun loungers, and complimentary self-parking. Guests consistently praise the exceptional staff and tasty food. See all romantic hotels in Krabi

What are the best hotels in Krabi near Laem Bong Beach?

For hotels in Krabi near Laem Bong Beach, consider Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, or The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort.

The 5-star Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, with an outstanding 9.8 rating, is located just 0.9 miles from Laem Bong Beach. This resort offers various amenities specifically for families, including complimentary cribs, sofa beds, and a children's club. Children's slippers, games, and a dedicated children's pool are also available, along with supervised childcare services.

Another excellent option is the 5-star The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort, which has a 9.6 rating and is 1.4 miles from Laem Bong Beach. This resort provides a complimentary buffet breakfast and free WiFi. Guests regularly praise the delicious food and the brilliant staff. Families will appreciate the free cribs and a playground for children. The resort also offers free self-parking and a 24-hour airport shuttle.

Where can I find the best nightlife in Krabi?

Krabi offers several distinct areas for nightlife, each with its own character.

Ao Nang is the primary tourist area and has the most concentrated nightlife. Along the main beach road and its side streets, you'll find numerous open-air bars, pubs with live music, and sports bars. Many establishments offer outdoor seating and stay open late. There are also several beach clubs that host evening events.

Railay Beach, accessible only by boat, offers a more relaxed nighttime experience. West Railay has a few upscale resort bars, while East Railay has a collection of smaller, more casual bars often built into the cliffs, many featuring fire shows and comfortable seating. It's a quieter option compared to Ao Nang.

Krabi Town, the provincial capital, has a more local feel. You'll find a few pubs and bars, particularly around the riverfront and the night markets.

Can I cancel my hotel reservation on Expedia?

You can cancel your hotel reservation on Expedia, though it depends on the cancellation policy of your booking. Most bookings are refundable if canceled within 24-48 hours of the scheduled arrival. Be sure to check your booking confirmation for the exact cancellation policy. If free cancellation is available, you can cancel directly through your Expedia account by logging in, going to "My Trips", and selecting your reservation. To find flexible deals, filter your search by "Fully refundable property" for hotels in Krabi.
